checkpoint_protocol.scope: Every RICH validation/ego index window: 206 windows from 27 eligible sequences; 28 source sequences include one short excluded source. Not TEST or an assumed external-paper protocol.

metric_protocol.joints: 22 common native SMPL/SMPL-X body joints, including pelvis; not a dataset official 14/17-joint regressor
metric_protocol.w_mpjpe_mm: World coordinates, no alignment; existing mpjpe_cm times 10
metric_protocol.root_relative_mpjpe_mm: Subtract each frame pelvis separately from prediction and GT; no rotation or scale alignment
metric_protocol.pa_mpjpe_mm: Per-frame proper rotation (no reflection), positive similarity scale and translation; all 22 joints
metric_protocol.mpjve_mm_s: World joint first-difference velocity error at explicit 30Hz, mm/s; no alignment
metric_protocol.acceleration_error_mm_s2: World joint second-difference acceleration error at explicit 30Hz, mm/s^2; no alignment
metric_protocol.temporal_boundaries: Only within each saved window, no differences across window boundaries; overlapping windows retained

checkpoint_protocol.timing_scope: Concurrent single GPU: evaluation and training throughput can differ from isolated measurements.

interpretation_limits: All eligible RICH windows from this frozen local official-validation index; not TEST and not automatically another paper's benchmark protocol.
192-frame, stride-64 windows overlap. Window count is not independent recording count; recording macro is reported separately.
Clean/noisy are paired versions of identical windows, not independent samples.
All-window count-weighted, equal-window and equal-recording means answer different weighting questions.
Count weighting uses only explicit matching effective counts; uncounted extras remain equal-window only.
Velocity/acceleration derivatives are evaluated inside each window; overlapping physical frames can occur repeatedly.
GT foot speed<0.2m/s is a low-speed kinematic proxy, not ground-truth contact; sliding is not penetration.
GT strata: moving root-horizontal path>=0.5m; near-static path<0.25m and both local-foot RMS<0.08m; otherwise mixed.
Per-window quantiles are across window means, not per-frame/joint percentiles or confidence intervals.
Root-relative and PA metrics remove specified transforms; global error remains separately reported.
Compare other ego methods only after matching split, inputs, scene scope, body/joint definitions, fps, alignment and metric units.
